title: Innokin Endura T22E Vape Kit
description: The Innokin T22E Starter Kit is a sleek yet robust device crafted to deliver a flavoursome, fulfilling vaping experience. Made from high-quality materials, this kit ensures durability and longevity, while its single-button operation makes it incredibly accessible for vapers of all experience levels. Powered by a 2000mAh rechargeable battery, you'll enjoy a fixed output of 14W that pairs seamlessly with the kit's 1.5-ohm replaceable coils. What makes these coils stand out is their construction using Japanese organic cotton wicking, which elevates flavour production to new heights. And with built-in safety features such as charging protection and overheating protection, you can vape with peace of mind. The kit also features a 2ml Prism T22E tank made from stainless steel and Pyrex glass. Filling the tank is hassle-free, thanks to its twist-top quick fill system. When it's time to charge, pass-through technology ensures that your vaping session remains uninterrupted. No more fumbling with messy coil replacements. The Innokin no-spill coil swap system makes it easy to switch out coils as needed, contributing to the kit's overall user-friendliness. Included in the kit are a Delrin© drip tip mouthpiece, replacement O-rings, a spare coil, and a micro USB charger. All in all, the Innokin T22E Starter Kit is a comprehensive package, providing everything you need for a satisfying vape experience, whether you're a beginner or an experienced vaper. Please note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
